item.title: Tan Siu Lin Foundation donates $10K to NMC Foundation
item.description: (NMC) — Continuing its support for higher education in the CNMI, the Tan Siu Lin Foundation has contributed $10,000 to the Northern Marianas College Foundation as a Platinum Sponsor of the upcoming NMC Golf Open, scheduled for March 21 and 22, 2026. The post Tan Siu Lin Foundation donates $10K to NMC Foundation appeared first on Marianas Variety News & Views.

item.title: Apatang meets with Guam governor and lt. governor to discuss IGIA priorities
item.description: (Office of the CNMI Governor) — Gov. David M. Apatang met with Guam Gov. Lou Leon Guerrero and Lt. Gov. Joshua Tenorio to engage in high-level discussions focused on mining issues, the Bureau of Environmental and Occupational Health, and the alignment of shared priorities across the Marianas region. The post Apatang meets with Guam governor and lt. governor to discuss IGIA priorities appeared first on Marianas Variety News & Views.

item.title: Fuel Adjustment Charge remains the same for February
item.description: (CUC) — The Commonwealth Utilities Corporation announces that the Fuel Adjustment Charge remains the same at $0.19706 per kWh for the month of February. Although there has been an increase in fuel costs, which would have raised the rate to $0.20067, CUC will not adjust the FAC in accordance with the Commonwealth Public Utilities Commission FAC Stabilization Order dated March 6, 2025. The post Fuel Adjustment Charge remains the same for February appeared first on Marianas Variety News & Views.

item.description: THE CNMI Small Business Development Center Network opened its 2026 Industry Day on Tuesday, highlighting federal contracting opportunities and strengthening connections between local entrepreneurs and military procurement officials. item.title: Proposed US Air Force project at Rota airport still under review
item.description: THE Commonwealth Ports Authority has not finalized a lease agreement with the United States Air Force for plans to build concrete pads at Rota’s airport runway for emergency aircraft stops, according to Rota Mayor Aubry Hocog. item.title: Garapan Central Park vandalized again
item.description: GARAPAN Central Park has been vandalized again and will be closed to the public, Division of Parks and Recreation Director Mike Cruz said. His office received a call Wednesday night from a Zumba group reporting that there was no electricity at the park. item.description: THE runway lights at Francisco C. Ada/Saipan International Airport went out Wednesday night, prompting the Commonwealth Ports Authority to temporarily halt aircraft arrivals and leading the board to approve an emergency expenditure of funds.
